page.description: The page id; default the file name.

under.description: Hang the page under each record of this entity type in the page tree.

params.description: Parameters, e.g. study: Ref<Study>, bound from the record it hangs under.

additionalProperties.description: A value type: Text, Money, Identifier(GSTIN), Quantity(kg), Enum[a, b], List<T>, Ref<Entity>, or a record type name.

items.description: kpi: { label, value: { count | percent | sum | avg: <Entity>, where, field, of }, target }, table: { title, view }, list: { title, view }, heatmap: { rows, columns }, text: markdown.
